name: minimax_m31_measured
notes: Measured on strata-m3 (UD-Q2_K_XL, one or two Tesla V100 PCIe 32GB, 2 x Xeon Gold 6240, 124.7 GiB pack in pinned RAM, --dspark --kv-f16), 2026-11-02/03. Every number below is a measurement; 'derived' marks arithmetic on measurements. Source tables: docs/MINIMAX_M31_SIM.md. Single runs unless a count is given.

dense_matvec_us.note: dense_mmvq_bench (tools: src/kernels/dense_mmvq_bench.cpp), engine defaults (one row per block, transposed reduction), microseconds per call for 1..8 columns; weight bytes derived from the tensor shapes

tensor_core_matvec_prototype_us.note: WMMA Q5_K prototype, q shape, flat in the column count

step_profile_max_mode_one_gpu.note: STRATA_M3_PROF=3, dijkstra prompt, --speed max, 79 verify steps of 4.1 rows on average, 3.8 tokens per step, before the side-stream change (ms per step unless noted)

union_law.note: distinct experts per layer for T consecutive tokens of one sequence = top_k * T * rho(T); from STRATA_M3_ROUTE_TRACE (route-short exact top-4, route-code top-3: the same ratios)

cross_sequence_ratio.note: unique experts of B windows of 4 tokens taken from different parts of the trace, divided by B times one window

cache_hit_unique_experts.note: tools/minimax_cache_policy_sim.py, freq policy, admit 2, route-code trace, B pseudo-sequences (the trace at B offsets) as windows of 4 tokens; hit rate per distinct expert per layer

decode_anchors_tok_s.note: mean of two runs per prompt (dijkstra / lru_cache), 200 new tokens (300 in max-mode); speculation on (DSpark, draft 6, pmin 0.7); final code

plain_decode_no_speculation.note: 210-token prompt, exact routing, --preload-experts --cpu-experts; before FP16 K/V, DSpark and the later kernels

prefill.note: 6960-token prompt, one 7168-token chunk, --pf-gemm --pf-prefetch --kv-f16, one V100; time in seconds
